## Description

Replace Medvya Web, Admin, Mobile and Foundations with the 12 Nov design. Record the gap between what is built (P2-E02 to P2-E05) and the design in the screen specs, and plan the stories MDV-P2-031 to P2-045. List the clinical sign-offs the design asks for (growth curves, vaccine schedules, drug rules) in the session handoff.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The four design files are the 12 Nov versions and the source README records the import and what changed.
- [ ] **AC2.** The screen specs describe the one-page chart, the life-stage modules, the one-page consultation and Add medicine, with what is already built.
- [ ] **AC3.** The session handoff lists the clinical sign-offs needed before the pilot uses the new rules.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
